items.description: SharePoint administrators can use the Inactive files policy in SharePoint Advanced Management to automatically archive files based on when they were last accessed. The public preview is available through PowerShell only. Admins can set an inactivity threshold from 6 to 48 months, scope policies to all SharePoint sites or selected sites, include or exclude file types and sites, and use What-If mode to review impact before activation. Eligible files move to the Microsoft 365 Archive cold-storage t

items.title: OneDrive: Presentation mode for PDFs in the iOS app on iPad
items.description: Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Add multiple items to a transaction using bulk entry
items.description:
Associates can trigger the Bulk add operation from the button grid on the transaction screen in Store Commerce. A drawer-based dialog opens where associates can paste or enter multiple item number and quantity pairs, with one pair specified per line.

Supported formats include SKU x quantity, quantity x SKU, SKU quantity, quantity SKU, or SKU only (which defaults the quantity to 1).
Multiple item number and quantity pairs can also be entered on a single line and separated by spaces or commas.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - Recurring conversation evaluations
items.description:
Quality Evaluation now supports recurring frequency for conversation evaluations. Previously, only event-based trigger evaluations were supported, meaning evaluations were created only when a conversation closed.
With recurring evaluations, users can run bulk evaluations over previously closed conversations, evaluate future closed conversations, and sample selected conversations that match configured conditions. This enables ongoing quality monitoring, retrospective analysis, and targeted evalua

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video (deepfake) detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls.  Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences fo

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
items.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
items.description: Extend Microsoft Purview data security controls to the network layer to detect and protect sensitive data in text and prompts by integrating with Entra Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policies, and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, app

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
items.description: A new feature will be introduced on the main Classification page, allowing users to test files against all available classifiers to identify the presence of sensitive information. Users will have the option to select a single classifier or run tests across all classifiers. This capability is designed to help users identify sensitive content within files and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
items.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

items.title: Outlook: New Outlook for Windows for GCC-H and DoD
items.description: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be available for US Government clouds (GCC-H and DoD sovereign environments).

items.title: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
items.description: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
items.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Credential Scanning in Data Security Posture Agent
items.description: We're expanding the Data Security Posture Agent with a new credential scanning capability. Discover exposed credentials and data security risks across scoped locations. Assign scanning tasks to the agent, track progress across stages, and take action on prioritized findings. The agent scans selected data locations, analyzing scoped files to detect credentials, such as Microsoft Entra user credentials, private keys, and API tokens. Each finding includes a risk score, AI-generated insights, confid

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
items.description: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
items.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
items.description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Just in time protection (JIT) on SharePoint
items.description:
Microsoft has decided to not move forward with this feature.
Just-in-time
protection for SharePoint in Microsoft Purview DLP allows organizations to
extend protection to unclassified files in SharePoint and apply restrictions
defined in DLP policies at the time of egress.
